composition_subtypes.role: Maps each bit position to an integer mask of string indices where it is 1, enabling grouping of identical positions.
Precomputes binomial coefficients and Bell numbers via recurrence to count partitions of grouped bit positions.

payload.core_composition_summary: Uses bit masks to group bit positions by occurrence patterns across input strings, then multiplies precomputed Bell numbers (via DP) per group count.
payload.rationale: Bit manipulation aggregates input bits into masks; DP precomputes Bell numbers for combinatorial counting of good sets.
